Convert a Linear Model (lm) Object to Anytime-Valid lm (avlm)

Source: R/av_lm.R
av.lm.Rd

Converts an lm object into an anytime-valid version by storing a precision parameter g as an attribute and updating the object's class. The resulting object supports anytime-valid inference.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'lm'
av(model, g = 1, vcov_estimator = NULL, cluster = NULL, ...)

Arguments

model

An lm object from a linear model fit.

g

A positive precision parameter for the anytime-valid mixture (see Lindon et al., 2026, Section 4.3.1). It acts like a prior sample size: larger values favour smaller effects and give narrower intervals at large \(n\), at the cost of wider intervals at small \(n\). Use optimal_g to choose it for a target sample size. Default is 1.

vcov_estimator

Optional character string specifying the type of heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors to use. Must be one of "HC0", "HC1", "HC2", or "HC3". If NULL (default), no robust variance estimation is applied. Cannot be combined with cluster.

cluster

Optional cluster specification for cluster-robust standard errors. Either a vector of cluster identifiers, one per observation used in fitting model (e.g. a respondent or unit id); a one-sided formula such as ~ cyl; or a single column name such as "cyl". Formulas and column names are evaluated in the data the model was fit with, and rows dropped from the fit (by subset or missing values) are dropped from the clusters too. Only one-way clustering is supported. When supplied, standard errors are computed using the CR1 cluster-robust sandwich estimator (scaled by \(G/(G-1)\)), and the anytime-valid p-values and confidence intervals use \(G - 1\) (clusters minus one) as the denominator degrees of freedom, rather than \(n - p\) (observations minus coefficients), and the number of clusters \(G\) as the sample size, so g is on the cluster scale. The cluster-robust e-values and confidence sequences are those of Lindon (2026). Cannot be combined with vcov_estimator.

...

Additional arguments passed to or from other methods.

Value

An enhanced lm object of class avlm with anytime-valid inference capabilities.

References

Lindon, M., Ham, D. W., Tingley, M., and Bojinov, I. (2026). Anytime-Valid Inference in Linear Models with Applications to Regression-Adjusted Causal Inference. Journal of the American Statistical Association. doi:10.1080/01621459.2026.2692052

Lindon, M. (2026). Anytime-Valid Inference in Linear Models with Clustered Outcomes: Exact Multivariate Tests and Cluster-Robust Confidence Sequences. arXiv:2610.25613. https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25613

Examples

# Fit a linear model on the built-in mtcars dataset
fit <- lm(mpg ~ wt + hp, data = mtcars)

# Convert the standard lm object to an anytime-valid avlm object
av_fit <- av(fit, g = 1)

# Print the summary of the anytime-valid model
summary(av_fit)
#> 
#> Call:
#> lm(formula = mpg ~ wt + hp, data = mtcars)
#> 
#> Residuals:
#>    Min     1Q Median     3Q    Max 
#> -3.941 -1.600 -0.182  1.050  5.854 
#> 
#> Coefficients:
#>             Estimate Std. Error t value p value    
#> (Intercept) 37.22727    1.59879  23.285  < 2e-16 ***
#> wt          -3.87783    0.63273  -6.129 3.96e-05 ***
#> hp          -0.03177    0.00903  -3.519   0.0336 *  
#> ---
#> Signif. codes:  0 ‘***’ 0.001 ‘**’ 0.01 ‘*’ 0.05 ‘.’ 0.1 ‘ ’ 1
#> Residual standard error: 2.593 on 29 degrees of freedom
#> Multiple R-squared:  0.8268,	Adjusted R-squared:  0.8148
#> F-statistic: 69.21 on 2 and 29 DF,  p-value: 4.226e-10 
#> Anytime-Valid: TRUE (g = 1)

# With cluster-robust standard errors, clustering on number of carburetors
av_fit_cl <- av(fit, g = 1, cluster = ~ carb)
summary(av_fit_cl)
#> 
#> Call:
#> lm(formula = mpg ~ wt + hp, data = mtcars)
#> 
#> Residuals:
#>    Min     1Q Median     3Q    Max 
#> -3.941 -1.600 -0.182  1.050  5.854 
#> 
#> Coefficients:
#>              Estimate Std. Error t value p value  
#> (Intercept) 37.227270   2.334600  15.946   0.0107 *
#> wt          -3.877831   0.804623  -4.819   0.0677 .
#> hp          -0.031773   0.006293  -5.049   0.0602 .
#> ---
#> Signif. codes:  0 ‘***’ 0.001 ‘**’ 0.01 ‘*’ 0.05 ‘.’ 0.1 ‘ ’ 1
#> Multiple R-squared:  0.8268,	Adjusted R-squared:  0.8148
#> F-statistic: 60.46 on 2 and 5 DF,  p-value: 0.03875 
#> Anytime-Valid: TRUE (g = 1)
#> Robust Standard Error Type: CR1 
#> Clusters: 6 

# Equivalent ways of specifying the clusters
av_fit_cl <- av(fit, g = 1, cluster = "carb")
av_fit_cl <- av(fit, g = 1, cluster = mtcars$carb)
